playbookOutputs: Official Information Regulator of South Africa Information Officer Registration Certificate
Signed Information Officer Designation Letter / Mandate
playbookCommonFailures: Information Regulator eServices portal rejects registration if the company CIPC registration number is already linked to a forgotten user account
Information Officer email address cannot receive the Information Regulator verification OTP link

informationToProvide.label: Information Officer Full Name, Email, Phone & Directorship Role
informationToProvide.aiHint: The head of the private body (CEO, MD, partner, or sole proprietor) or their formally designated deputy.

informationToProvide.label: CIPC Company Registration Certificate
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company registration document showing registration number and registered office.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copy of the Designated Information Officer (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a certified SA ID copy (< 3 months) of the appointed Information Officer (and Deputy IO, if applicable).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Signed Information Officer Designation Letter / Board Resolution (We Draft This for Signature if Needed)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the signed Information Officer authorisation/designation letter on company letterhead.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed designation letter or board resolution appointing the Information Officer (and any Deputy Information Officer) under POPIA.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect Information Officer and company details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Officer details and CIPC data confirmed

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit registration on Information Regulator portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Officer registered and official registration certificate generated

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver official Information Officer Certificate to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate and compliance guidelines posted to Communication History
